bluesky.text:
I can't yet picture a European local government justifying paying for Claude or ChatGPT, knowing those companies hold data — anonymized or not — that a foreign authority could leverage whenever it suited their interests.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-298957832

Spreadsheets are practical and powerful tools. The key is not to treat them as the final home of your organization's data.

Store data, not just files.

https://automato.substack.com/p/files-vs-data-the-first-step-toward

The AI engineer needs to think like a product manager, plan like a project manager, and execute like an engineer.

The human is in charge of judgment and tooling. AI processes the information. The human assumes the responsibility.

https://automato.substack.com/p/ai-new-way-of-work-clues

48 people who work with AI answered six questions. Two-thirds say AI is already replacing jobs in their field, or will within two years. Yet only 4 of the 48 feel strongly threatened.

They see it coming, and they are not afraid.

https://automato.substack.com/p/where-is-ai-heading-in-october-2026
